relationships.subject: EZH2
relationships.evidence_quote: Enhancer of zeste homolog 2 (EZH2), an important epigenetic regulator, regulates gene expression mainly through the PRC2-dependent trimethylation of histone H3 at lysine 27 (H3K27me3).

key_findings: Review of EZH2/H3K27me3 roles in osteoporosis, osteoarthritis, degenerative spinal disease and sarcopenia, and prospects for EZH2 inhibitors.
